import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_69/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_69/test_1.csv"
    source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_69/test_2.csv"

    # Load source tables
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, dtype={'user_id': int, 'year_school': str, 'floor': str})
    df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, dtype={'user_id': int, 'party': str, 'libcon': str})
    df2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, dtype={'user_id': int, 'fav_music': str})

    # Merge source tables on 'user_id'
    # Step 1: Merge df0 and df1 on 'user_id'
    df_01 = pd.merge(df0, df1, on='user_id', how='inner')

    # Step 2: Merge the result with df2 on 'user_id'
    df_final = pd.merge(df_01, df2, on='user_id', how='inner')

    # Select and reorder columns to match target schema
    target_columns = ['user_id', 'year_school', 'floor', 'party', 'libcon', 'fav_music']
    df_final = df_final[target_columns]

    # Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
    df_final = df_final.astype({
        'user_id': 'int64',
        'year_school': 'string',
        'floor': 'string',
        'party': 'string',
        'libcon': 'string',
        'fav_music': 'string'
    })

    # Write the result to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_69/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_final.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
